events.title: KAIST opens a Korean-English multimodal web agent built from scratch
events.title_zh: KAIST 开源从头训练的韩英双语多模态 web agent
events.summary: KAIST MLP Lab released KORMo-Web-11B, an Apache-2.0 Korean-English model that combines language, vision and browser interaction. It extends a foundation model trained from scratch with more than 10 million bilingual web-pretraining samples and over 100,000 interaction trajectories. Weights, a browser harness and vLLM instructions are public.
events.summary_en: KAIST MLP Lab released KORMo-Web-11B, an Apache-2.0 Korean-English model that combines language, vision and browser interaction. It extends a foundation model trained from scratch with more than 10 million bilingual web-pretraining samples and over 100,000 interaction trajectories. Weights, a browser harness and vLLM instructions are public.
events.summary_zh: KAIST MLP Lab 发布 KORMo-Web-11B：一个采用 Apache-2.0 的韩英双语模型，合并语言、视觉与浏览器操作能力。它在从头训练的基础模型上增加超过 1,000 万条双语网页预训练样本和 10 万多条交互轨迹。权重、browser harness 与 vLLM 指南均已公开。
events.why_it_matters: This adds a testable non-English open web agent rather than another English-only benchmark. Publisher evaluation reports 30.1% success on Korean Online-Mind2Web, but each model used its own prompt and action format and proprietary GPT-6 Luna remained far ahead.
events.why_it_matters_en: This adds a testable non-English open web agent rather than another English-only benchmark. Publisher evaluation reports 30.1% success on Korean Online-Mind2Web, but each model used its own prompt and action format and proprietary GPT-6 Luna remained far ahead.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 这增加了一个可验证的非英语开放 web agent，而不是又一个英语 benchmark。发布方在韩语 Online-Mind2Web 报告 30.1% 成功率；但各模型使用不同 prompt 和动作格式，而且专有 GPT-6 Luna 仍明显领先。

technical_details.capabilities: Korean-English LLM, VLM and screenshot-driven GUI agent
technical_details.training: 10M+ bilingual atomic web samples and 100K+ interaction trajectories
technical_details.artifacts: Weights, Transformers 5 loader, vLLM conversion, Playwright browser harness and Chrome extension
technical_details.evaluation: 612 live-site tasks: 29.0% English and 30.1% Korean Online-Mind2Web
technical_details.evidence_limit: Publisher-run; model-specific prompts/action formats; proprietary GPT-6 Luna scored 63.0% English and 65.7% Korean

technical_details_zh.能力: 韩英双语 LLM、VLM 与基于截图的 GUI agent
technical_details_zh.训练: 1,000 万+ 双语网页原子样本、10 万+ 交互轨迹
technical_details_zh.公开产物: 权重、Transformers 5 loader、vLLM 转换、Playwright browser harness、Chrome extension
technical_details_zh.评测: 612 个真实网站任务：Online-Mind2Web 英语 29.0%、韩语 30.1%
technical_details_zh.证据限制: 发布方评测；各模型 prompt/动作格式不同；专有 GPT-6 Luna 为英语 63.0%、韩语 65.7%

events.next_action_zh: 一天内在 20 个韩英双语站点任务上测成功率、错误动作、恢复能力、显存和自定义 loader 风险。
events.next_action_en: Within one day, test 20 Korean-English web tasks for success, bad actions, recovery, memory and custom-loader risk.
